application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: https://doi.org/10.3390/en15041342 (Jacqué, K. et al., Energies 15, 1342, 2022), Sec. 2.1.2: the lithium units 5 to 8 are an LMO/NMC blend; other units from https://doi.org/10.18154/RWTH-2024-04895, p. 3 unit table

units_released.note: Rule: battery units; the plant connection point is not a unit. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: https://doi.org/10.18154/RWTH-2024-04895, p. 3 table wiring: LMO 4 x 192s16p, LFP 240s10p, LTO 312s32p

cells_leadacid.source: https://doi.org/10.18154/RWTH-2024-04895, p. 3 table wiring: Pb2 300s1p, Pb3 308s2p, Pb4 306s1p
cells_leadacid.note: Pb1 (300s1p) excluded; it is counted under m5bat-pbacid.

cell_channels_measured.note: Unit CSVs carry unit-level voltage, current, power and SOC only.

energy_mwh.source: https://doi.org/10.18154/RWTH-2024-04895, p. 3 table (Pb1 630 kW / 1066 kWh; overall M5BAT 6.19 MW / 7.78 MWh); 7.78 MWh overall stated minus Pb1's stated 1.066 MWh, which is counted under m5bat-pbacid

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is the report's stated overall rating minus Pb1's stated rating (both stated values)

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://publications.rwth-aachen.de/record/985923; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention

overlap_identifiers.note: Unit Pb1 of the M5BAT plant is the string released separately as m5bat-pbacid; the data confirm it (see the identity check). It is counted once. Batt1 voltage correlates 0.997 with m5bat-pbacid's string voltage on 2023-04-10 (UTC) (Batt2: 0.409).
